body:
Riley (AE): FYI Im kicking off a POC with MeridianPay (fintech). They need eu-west-1 residency for test data, SOC2 evidence before we accept real payloads, and are asking if we can front-load credits for a month 1 burst.

Priya (AM): Got it. Any traffic estimates?

Eliot (SE): Quick sim: baseline ~500k tokens/mo, spikes to ~1.2M in month 1 for full ingest + embedding batch runs. Mostly embeddings + some chat gen. Latency matters.

Riley (AE): They're in an accelerator but not eligible for our standard startup credits. Asking for a one-off promo to cover the spike.

Sam (RevOps): Create a Deal Desk ticket. We need proposed terms.

Riley (AE): Proposed:
- Length: 90-day technical POC
- Month1 burst allowance: up to 1.2M tokens
- Baseline: 500k tokens/mo thereafter during POC
- Promo credits: $6k applied upfront (month1), $2k month2, $1k month3 (total $9k)
- No commit required post-POC
- Data residency: restrict calls to eu-west-1 endpoint
- Security: require SOC2 Type II evidence or signed attestation within 10 business days before ingesting sensitive data
- Legal: DPA + PII minimization + 30-day log retention for POC

Priya (AM): We should make credits conditional on SOC2 attestation or submission of evidence. If not provided, allow synthetic data only and no credits. Also want a 45-day check-in to assess conversion signal.

Eliot (SE): Ops note: we can do a region-restricted hosted endpoint quickly with ACL rules. Private deployment is possible but adds ~5 business days lead time. Ping me if they insist on Private.

Sam (RevOps): Numbers look ok from finance. Need Legal sign-off on clause that voids credits if PII is sent before SOC2 clearance. Also clarify what happens if they exceed credit cap.

LegalOps: I will draft the clause. Also recommend explicit 30-day retention and deletion after POC unless customer agrees to longer.

Riley (AE): ARR upside if they convert -- expect ~3M tokens/mo reserved -> $8-12k/mo. Low risk to approve credits conditionally.

DealDeskBot: DD-4410 created for MeridianPay POC credits + residency. Link: https://redwood.com/internal/deals/DD-4410

Sam (RevOps): I provisionally approve a $9k capped credit package conditional on: LegalOps clause added, SOC2 attestation/evidence within 10 business days, and explicit retention + PII restrictions. If not met, consumed tokens billed at list.

LegalOps: Drafted clause and pushed to DD-4410. Key line: "Credits void if unredacted PII or production customer data is processed prior to verified SOC2 evidence; consumed usage will be invoiced at list rates."

Priya (AM): Good. I'll add the 45-day ROI checkpoint to the POC plan and share success criteria with MeridianPay.

Riley (AE): I'll send the SOC2 evidence request today and update the deal. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Eliot (SE): If they ask for private infra, need approval from EngInfra asap. I'll standby.

DealDeskBot: DD-4410 status: Pending LegalOps signoff recorded at 1779991175.
